items.source: Alternative to StompWebSocketEndpointRegistration.setAllowedOrigins(String...) that supports more flexible patterns for specifying the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 替代StompWebSocketEndpointRegistration.setAllowedOrigins(String...)，支持更灵活的浏览器跨域请求允许源模式。
`StompWebSocketEndpointRegistration` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation` 包中的用法

items.source: Support for annotation-based WebSocket setup in configuration classes.
items.translation: 支持在配置类中使用基于注解的 WebSocket 设置。

items.source: An abstract base class for configuring STOMP over WebSocket/SockJS endpoints.
items.translation: 用于配置基于 WebSocket/SockJS 的 STOMP 端点的抽象基类。

items.source: Register a STOMP over WebSocket endpoint at the given mapping path.
items.translation: 在指定的映射路径处注册一个基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP 端点。

items.source: Set the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 设置允许浏览器发起跨域请求的源。
